IdInvoice.description: Related invoice. Present only if the line has been billed.

IdFeature.description: Related feature. Present only for feature-related fees.

DateMove.description: Date of the fee. Present only for punctual fees.

DatePeriodStart.description: Billing period start. Present only for time-based fees.

DatePeriodEnd.description: Billing period end. Present only for time-based fees.

StateMove.description:
State of a balance line.

* `Due` — amount is due but not yet billed
* `Adjustment` — adjustment entry
* `Billed` — included in an invoice
* `Credited` — reversed by a credit
* `Unpaid` — invoice unpaid
* `Cancelled` — entry was cancelled
* `Deleted` — deleted
StateMove.title: StateMove

AmountTotal.description: Total amount including taxes, in cents.

LabelTax.description: Tax label in the language of the customer.

RateTax.description: Tax rate, in basis points, where `2000` means 20%.

TypeLine.description:
Type of a balance line entry.

* `AutoBillingReport` — balance from the previous billing period, used when a billing operation ends with a positive balance; the amount is reported on the next invoice
* `AutoBillingNoRepayment` — amount carried over to the next billing period, stacked in the customer moves to balance the account
* `AutoRefundPartial` — partial refund of a paid invoice
* `AutoSubscriptionRecurrence` — flat fee of a subscription
* `AutoSubscriptionRecurrenceProrata` — prorated flat fee of a subscription, used when upgrading
* `AutoSubscriptionUpfront` — upfront fee of a subscription
* `AutoSubscriptionTrial` — trial fee of a subscription
* `AutoSubscriptionTrialProrata` — prorated trial fee of a subscription, used when upgrading in a paying trial
* `AutoSubscriptionTermination` — termination fee of a subscription
* `AutoFeatureNotProratable` — computed feature fee when subscribing or renewing; never refunded in case of an upgrade
* `AutoFeatureProratable` — computed feature fee when subscribing or renewing; partially refunded in case of an upgrade if the period is not over
* `AutoFeatureProrata` — prorated adjustment on a feature, used when the quantity changes on a proratable feature
* `AutoDiscountRecurrenceFlat` — discount on the flat fee of a subscription
* `AutoDiscountRecurrencePercent` — discount percentage on the flat fee of a subscription
* `AutoDiscountUpfrontFlat` — discount on the upfront fee of a subscription
* `AutoDiscountUpfrontPercent` — discount percentage on the upfront fee of a subscription
* `AutoDiscountFeatureFlat` — discount on a feature fee
* `AutoDiscountFeaturePercent` — discount percentage on a feature fee
* `Manual` — unspecified manual input
* `ManualDiscount` — manual input: discount
* `ManualMergeable` — mergeable manual input
* `CustomerReferral` — referral program; not used by the system
* `CreditRefund` — credit: refund on an overpayment
* `CreditPromotion` — credit: promotional operation
TypeLine.title: TypeLine
